headline: UK Regulator Suspends Petra Diamonds Shares After Audit Delay
summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority suspended Petra Diamonds' shares from London trading after the mining company failed to publish its annual financial report by the regulatory deadline.
why: Trading suspensions by primary regulators block liquidity and signal severe compliance or financial reporting issues, creating uncertainty for equity holders.

impacts.name: Petra Diamonds
impacts.why: Share suspension halts trading, directly restricting liquidity and equity access.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The regulatory suspension of shares directly prevents investors from trading the stock on the London Stock Exchange.
